title: Best Plush Toy (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen from sources that directly reviewed plush toys. Products mentioned by more than one source were prioritized, and the list includes AI‑enabled bears and weighted cuddle toys.
assumptions: Only products with explicit mentions were included; no price data was added unless a source gave a figure.

verdict.line: Ideal for anyone seeking calming comfort, Warmies provide gentle pressure and can be heated or cooled for relief. They are praised for soothing anxiety and are the best overall weighted option, though they lack interactive features.
